title: Finite true W32 S68/S72 positional T_f=21186 and D6 zero under fixed g

quantifiers.domain: integer h=1, s=2^h=2, only genuine finite original W(3,2)
the specific complete original globally injected K6 S68 and S72 point/line fixture assignments
full original 45-incidence ID positional tensor source/dual cross-check on all relevant original Q and 60 labelled C6

statement: For the genuine original W(3,2) physical K6 globally injected source fixtures S68 and S72, the point-first and original-source-major 60-fibre tensor enumerators agree exactly at T_f=21186 for each fixed point map f. Therefore E_g D6(f,g)|f = 21186/5005 = 1926/455 under one uniform complete opposite source-line injection g. Yet for each specified complete fixed right g in S68/S72, the ACTUAL original aligned D6(f,g)=0 while full seven-positive S_s values are respectively 68 and 72. This is a finite exact quantifier obstruction, not an all-h low-S counterfamily.
external_dependencies: Original independently enumerated W(3,2) 45 incidence-ID point-first 60-cycle and source-major original Q positional tensor oracles; historical seven-positive GF(5) classifier.
Frozen S68 and S72 physical K6 fully typed global injection fixtures from source PR484.
limitations: Actual D6=0 at s=2 does not imply all-seven S_s=0 or an infinite family with S_s=o(s^6).
Positive conditional mean at each fixed f does not force positivity at the particular fixed g.
A finite example does not prove or disprove the all-h scientific root conjecture.
falsification_boundary: Independently validate true GQ W(3,2) unique-anchor incidence, all 45 original incidence IDs and both complete K6 global assignments; do not treat T_f as the realized D6 or substitute physical paths.
